text: Users with more than 100 items only ever see their newest 100 on the Items page, and the admin page stops at 100 users. `getItemsQueryOptions` in `frontend/src/routes/_layout/items.tsx` always calls `ItemsService.readItems` with `skip: 0, limit: 100`, and `getUsersQueryOptions` in `frontend/src/routes/_layout/admin.tsx` does the same with `UsersService.readUsers`. `DataTable` in `frontend/src/components/Common/DataTable.tsx` then paginates only that first slice on the client and ignores the `count` that `read_items` and `read_users` in `backend/app/api/routes/` already return. Its "of N entries" text and page count are built from `data.length`, so anything past 100 never appears. Can you fix this so paging through the tables reaches every item and user exactly once, using `skip`/`limit` and the returned `count`?

Goal: add an importer that loads item records from partner export drops into the `item` table (`Item` in backend/app/models.py). None of this exists yet.
- Create a new package backend/app/importers/ with a CLI module `load_items.py`. It reads drops from `exports/items/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/*.json`, with the base directory taken from a `--source-dir` option. Each drop also contains a manifest.json with the per-partner item counts.
- Three partner systems write these files, and their field names differ slightly (`created` vs `created_at`, `owner_email` vs `user_email`). Put the field mapping in a new backend/app/importers/mappings.py, one dict per partner.
- Normalize `created_at` to UTC. One partner writes local time. For its files, use per-partner offsets from a new backend/app/importers/partner_timezones.csv.
- Resolve `owner_id` from the email with `crud.get_user_by_email`.
- Dedupe on (owner_id, title, created_at) before insert.
- The load must be idempotent: rerunning a date replaces the items loaded from that date's drop and never appends.
- Add a small sample drop for 2026-10-20, with its manifest.json, so the command can be run.
Acceptance: running `uv run python -m app.importers.load_items --date 2026-10-20` from backend/ twice leaves the same row count in `item`, and the item count per partner matches that drop's manifest.json.
